summary: The diff implements a dark neon-themed multi-view UI (landing/generate/history), an image picker with validation and preview metadata, on-device variation generation via canvas filters, hide/restore/regenerate UI for variations, and localStorage-based history. However, the landing manifesto content and required static branding images are not evidenced, and the variation pipeline does not clearly meet the “background variation” aspect. Several unrequested features/links were added (e.g., caffeine.ai footer link, backend enumeration of all users with history).

missing_requirements.requirement: Create a landing/intro experience that displays the full provided introduction/manifesto text and the provided tagline exactly as written (including the Louis Vuitton URL).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary does not include the LandingIntro page content, so there is no evidence that the exact title/tagline/full manifesto text (including https://www.louisvuitton.com) is rendered in the UI.
evidence: frontend/src/App.tsx (references LandingIntro but does not show content)

missing_requirements.requirement: Generate multiple realistic variations that preserve the subject while varying only background and/or overall styling (minimum 4), with larger view and download.
missing_requirements.reason: On-device generation shown applies global pixel adjustments (temperature/brightness/contrast/saturation), vignette, grain, and full-image blur; there is no evidence of background-only changes (segmentation/masking) or explicit background variation. Also, the UI that enforces minimum 4 and configurable count is not evidenced (UploadAndGenerate page not shown).
evidence: frontend/src/lib/onDeviceVariations.ts (global canvas filter pipeline; no masking/background replacement shown)
frontend/src/components/VariationGrid.tsx (download/view exists, but generation count controls not evidenced)

missing_requirements.requirement: Include the user-provided Ko T T1c images as static frontend assets and use them visibly in the UI (at least one on the landing screen), served from frontend static assets (not via backend).
missing_requirements.reason: No static image assets or references to the required filenames are shown in the provided diff summary, and LandingIntro implementation is not visible to confirm placement.
evidence: No evidence in shown files of references to: ko-tt1c-app-icon.dim_512x512.png, ko-tt1c-hero-bg.dim_1600x900.png, ko-tt1c-favicon.dim_64x64.png

hallucinated_features.description: Footer includes an outbound marketing/referral link to caffeine.ai with UTM parameters.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested in any requirement and adds external branding/linking behavior.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend exposes a query to list all user principals with history (getAllUsersWithHistory).
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-5 only requires a user to revisit their own history; enumerating all users is not requested and may be privacy-sensitive.

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity authentication plumbing/hooks were added (InternetIdentityProvider/useInternetIdentity/useActor) even though authentication was not requested.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly notes third-party auth is a non-goal and only mentions II as a possibility if later requested; current requirements do not require login/auth to satisfy the described UX.
